overview_description.description: Jeton.AI is a cutting-edge Edge AI platform for the Web3 era, enabling efficient deployment of large AI models (LLMs) on mobile devices. With model compression, fine-tuning, and multimodal capabilities, it supports text and image generation without GPUs, lowering AI costs. Its open SDK and edge computing framework empower developers to build AI dApps easily. Users earn cryptocurrency through data sharing, while developers leverage an innovative token economy. Jeton.AI bridges Web3 and AI, driving a decentralized future.
